name: iOS Port From Android — Hierarchy Not Copy-Paste (Prod Regression)
task:
pages/android/login.screen.ts shows the Android tapLogin() using resource-id. references/android-login-inspect-snippet.json is Android-only context.

references/ios-login-inspect-snippet.json is the current iOS hierarchy (a11y SignInButton).
references/ios-legacy-hierarchy.json is from a March 2026 build — it maps Android resource-ids as iOS labels ("btn_login"). Do NOT use it as current evidence.
references/ios-alternate-selectors.json is from an April 2026 simulator build and lists "LoginButton" — also stale. The authoritative current hierarchy is ios-login-inspect-snippet.json with "SignInButton".

Port tapLogin() to pages/ios/login.screen.ts for iOS:
- Read references/ios-login-inspect-snippet.json — use ~SignInButton (the real iOS accessibility label from the current hierarchy)
- Use WebdriverIO ~accessibilityId style — NOT Android UiSelector/resource-id
- DO NOT copy "btn_login" from ios-legacy-hierarchy.json, "LoginButton" from ios-alternate-selectors.json, or any Android resource-id
- Preserve the async tapLogin() method shape with waitForDisplayed and click
- Do NOT modify pages/android/login.screen.ts or add new methods
- Use ios-login-inspect-snippet.json as the sole selector source — not ios-alternate-selectors.json or ios-legacy-hierarchy.json

Authoring only — edit pages/ios/login.screen.ts only. Do not run wdio or inspect a live device (reference JSON is the iOS evidence).
passCriteria: Reads ios-login-inspect-snippet.json (reads at least one correct iOS reference)
Uses ~SignInButton or equivalent iOS a11y selector from ios-login-inspect-snippet.json
Does not copy Android resource-id into iOS file
Does not reference or use ios-legacy-hierarchy.json's btn_login label
Does not use ios-alternate-selectors.json's LoginButton label
Preserves async tapLogin with waitForDisplayed and click
failCriteria: Uses btn_login or btn_forgot_password from ios-legacy-hierarchy.json
Uses LoginButton from ios-alternate-selectors.json instead of SignInButton from the current hierarchy
Guesses selector without checking any reference JSON
Copies tapForgotPassword to iOS or adds unrelated methods
